name: Mark Evans

name: Starbuck Rogers

name: Harkness Torchwood

name: Wesley Sheridan

name: Isaac Binks

name: Optimum Limbo

name: Panacea Utopia
desc: His tricky moves confuse the opposing team, throwing them into disarray.

name: Acme Rapture

name: Ultima Nextworld

name: Maxim Millennium

name: Infinity Beyond

name: Apex Paradiso

name: Pearl Gates

name: Perpetuo Xanadu
desc: Displays incredible concentration skills, but only at critical moments.

name: Myriad Arcadia
desc: Collects toy banknotes because it makes him feel like a millionaire.

name: Primo Eden

name: Preston Princeton

name: Dracon Yale

name: Duke Dartmouth

name: Cameron Cambridge

name: Earl Eton

name: Baron Oxford

name: Arthur Ascot

name: Stuart St John

name: Wenceslas Wales
desc: Favours a solid and reliable style of play, well grounded in theory.

name: Yorick York

name: Jude Sharp

name: David Samford
desc: Royal Academy's ever-loyal assistant coach, always backing up Manager Jude.

name: Ishmael Ahab

name: Octavus Kraken
desc: His trademark is an unusual kick where he snaps his leg forward like a whip.

name: Calico Corsair

desc: At night, he always sleeps curled up with a blanket over his head.

name: Bart Black
desc: His abilities are excellent, but his rebellious attitude can cause trouble.

name: Frank Drake

name: Leon Ohnepart
desc: Closes in on the opponent in a flash with movements honed to perfection.

name: Robert Lee

name: Salvador Addin
desc: A skilled player, but quite headstrong. Not great at coordinating with others.

name: Otto Bismark
desc: His grandfather was German. Rather straight-laced and by-the-book.

name: Jean Darc
desc: Has no flashy moves of his own, but provides valuable support to the team.

name: Bobby Bruce

name: Hanny Bawl
desc: A military gear junkie who snacks on ration packs like candy.

name: Sturm Schwartzkopf

name: Wolfe Whyte

name: Sascha Kotch

name: Matther Horne
desc: Often helps out at the port warehouse, and has the muscles to show for it.

name: Iggie Loo

name: Bob Sled
desc: Does environmental work, teaching tourists not to feed the local wildlife.

name: Blain Chills

name: Art Tundra

name: Borel Aurora

name: Njord Snio
desc: The hottest striker of the north, scouted out by Shawn Froste.

name: Yule Hoarfrost

name: Suno Aisu

name: Himesh Himalaya
desc: Studying the local deer population and seeking ways to preserve their habitat.

name: Blake Wintry

name: Fritz Brisk

name: Wilder Bigfoot

name: Strom Boojum
desc: Seems like a tough, opinionated guy, but is actually kind of mellow.

desc: Practices his regatta skills rowing down the river. He's pretty macho.

name: Bourne Birch

name: Flynt Pine
desc: Likes to dart around here and there, leaving his opponent in disarray.

name: Trent Poplar
desc: Enjoys going jogging around the local lakes and ponds.

name: River Willows
desc: At night he plays guitar and sings as a street musician.

name: Beck Heath
desc: His family has an esteemed history in traditional theatre.

name: Brook Linden
desc: Has a short fuse—he's liable to get heated up about the smallest things.

name: Bay Laurel

name: Langford Ash
desc: Bradford's older brother. Confident, but can get rather arrogant at times.

name: Escott Aspen

name: Bradford Ash
desc: Langford's little brother. He loves his big bro but sometimes feels inferior.

name: Calder Elm
desc: Wants to become a pro player and earn money to help out his family.

name: Laike Alder
desc: Researches ways to restore polluted lakes and marshes back to normal.

name: Tahoma Sequoia
desc: Freshwater fish are his favorite food, so he often goes fishing in rivers.

name: Abram Cadabra
desc: Has amazing reflexes for his size, and considers penalty kicks his specialty.

name: Jaymes Randie
desc: His family owns a lot of land. Their spring water is quite popular locally.

name: Daffyd Blayne
desc: Spent a year alone in the mountains honing his skills to perfection.

name: Al Kazam
desc: Heir to a family of traditional dancers. His strict upbringing has left its mark.

name: Sigfryd Roi
desc: A hobbyist trick art illustrator with big dreams, currently planning his first gallery show.

name: Dave Coppfielder
desc: Uses astrology to predict events, but isn't great at split-second decisions.

name: Launce Berton

name: Ledger Demain
desc: Claims to be able to see things that others can't, but isn't able to prove it.

name: Harrold Houdini
desc: Famously stony-faced striker. Likes to subvert the opponent's expectations.

name: Hocus Sesame

name: Pen Teller
desc: A trickster who mixes in just enough truth to make his lies undetectable.

name: Petey Sorcar
desc: Enjoys surprising others with sleight of hand. Always inventing new tricks.

name: Trump Loyal
desc: His beady eyes make him look shady, but he's really honest and upstanding.

name: Daren Blakh
desc: Loves competitive card games and is always scouting for his next opponent.

name: Billy Lingsoo
desc: Has the unusual talent of performing acrobatics while balancing on a ball.

name: Ringo Saturn

name: Auberon Ouranos
desc: His eagle eyes lead some to believe he has two more in the back of his head.

name: Manning Moon
desc: Able to predict the night's weather just by reading the morning sky.

name: Terran Gaea
desc: Watches a lot of gangster movies, but on the pitch he's a model of decency.

name: Crateris Mercury
desc: Able to control the ball with beautiful fluid motions, like water in a stream.

name: Nix Pluto
desc: His status as a member of the team is sometimes called into question.

name: Neith Venus

name: Deimos Mars

name: Sol Daystar

name: Triton Nettuno

name: Astro Ceres
desc: Always doodles zigzag patterns in the empty spaces of his notebook.

name: Chiron Vestal

name: Xeno Eris

name: Namak Haumea
desc: Proud of the fact that he never catches colds and his injuries heal super fast.

name: Mac Emake

name: Hailey Cometti

name: Theo Divine

name: Mnemo Pool

name: Phoebus Moonlight

name: Hyperion Wise

name: Cronus Fourseasons

name: Coeus Heavens

desc: Hasn't grown at all for a few years, so he looks much younger than he is.

desc: Obsessed with mastering the perfect free kick. Doesn't care about goals.

name: Orion Hunter

name: Alex Zabel

name: Dave Quagmire

name: Federigo Cinco

name: Ferdinand Delafünfe
desc: Somewhat excitable, he can get worked up over the smallest things.

name: Quinque Flores
desc: Considers all who oppose him to be evil, and football a kind of purification.

name: Jacques Cinquini
desc: Able to turn the tiniest opening into an attacking opportunity.

name: Fivier Saviola

name: David Quintola

name: Erik Pentona
desc: Honed his spirit in a mountain retreat, giving him incredible concentration.

name: George Wu

name: Geert Vandevijf
desc: Takes pictures of lighthouses at night. Wants to tour the world someday.

name: Folke Fem

name: Naji Khamsa
desc: Always wanted to make a wish upon a falling star, but has never seen one.

name: Albion Lumina
desc: Possesses a perfect poker face, so nobody can tell what he is thinking.

desc: Wary and distrustful. Never completely honest, even with his own teammates.

name: Dwight Whittaker

name: Beamer Daye

name: Chandler Blanc
desc: Doesn't show emotion very often, but when he is angry, anyone can see it.

name: Dawntavius Spectrum
desc: Looks unimposing, but kicks with the force of a speeding bullet.

name: Brighton Spark
desc: A supporting player with excellent communication skills. An unsung hero.

name: Laban Lux
desc: Uses self-taught martial art skills to weave through any attack.

name: Bailong

name: Filbert Weissman
desc: A formidable striker whose eyes are always on the goal.

name: Nero Night
desc: Knows a lot about wild grasses. Often gathers herbs in the countryside.

name: Morris Moore

name: Jet Onyx
desc: If he holds out his hand above a field, the grass lies down and forms a path.

name: Cole Ebony
desc: Regularly prunes the trees in the local forest to keep them in tip-top shape.

name: Blake Obscura
desc: His hobby is creating works of art using charcoal.

name: Shady Shwartz
desc: Crafts musical instruments, such as xylophones and castanets, from wood.

name: Goth Grimshaw
desc: Loves to read novels set in the past. Has real respect for historical figures.

name: Duff Dooley
desc: Loves any kind of dish involving turnips. Eats them almost every day.

name: Tynan Crowe
desc: His dream is to climb every mountain in the whole of Japan.

name: Tezcat

name: Yang
desc: His attitude seems carefree, but he's actually a calm and shrewd strategist.

name: Pinkus Mountbatten
desc: The manager of the Sanctum training facility. An ace player despite his age.

name: Flint Charcoal
desc: A Sanctum trainer. His passes are said to be practically unstoppable.

desc: A Sanctum trainer. Her cool head and wits let her build the perfect defence.

name: Gus Martin
desc: An instructor at Sanctum... though how he landed the job remains a mystery.

name: Cinereous Slate
desc: A Sanctum trainer. His fine judgement makes him a superb goalkeeper.

name: Damien Blackloch
desc: A mysterious boy. Has travelled far and wide, but no one knows why.

name: Xavier Shotwell

name: Crimson Wiseman

name: Linden Haregrove

name: Jared Dapplegrey
desc: The "Sudden Stampede." Normally calm, he is unstoppable when riled up.

name: Keith Wellington
desc: The "Horned Buffalo." It is unclear if his hairdo is intentional or not.

name: Cirrus Whisp
desc: The "Royal Pharaoh." Well-respected, but his origins are a mystery to all.

name: Gamal Everlast
desc: Called the "Prince of the Desert" for his ability to play in the blazing heat.

name: Sandy Dryhill
desc: Like the sand itself. Supports his team without drawing too much attention.

name: Dryden Zephyr

name: Solomon Roundhay

name: Harry Dwind

name: Locke Saflowe

desc: A speedy player who hides in the shadows and mounts sneak attacks.

name: Bill Froger

name: Romeo Fitzroy

name: Caesar Lionheart

name: Stan Roller

name: Bracknell Forge

name: Vivian Doosley

name: Buck Tucker

name: Edward Headwood
desc: An unlikely bonsai gardener. The green on his head may actually be foliage...

name: Reed Maind

name: Chuck Pumpkins

name: Filbert Chestnut

name: Autumn Leaf

name: Guy-Jean Harvestman

name: Jack Balance

desc: Raised in a family of folk dance masters, every move he makes is pure elegance crafted to perfection.

name: Dyne Amic
desc: Athletic and unstoppable on the pitch, yet somehow just as spectacular at flunking exams.

name: Callista Norton
desc: She rules the court with a bright smile so genuine you can't help but forgive her every win.

name: Neve Paisley
desc: Trained by a pro mom, her racket work is razor sharp and built for fierce competition.

name: Serene Goldwell
desc: New money by one generation, she polishes every move to look every bit the refined elite.

name: Mirko Harding
desc: No matter the game, his uncanny knack for tracking the ball makes him look like a natural star.

name: Clyde Dalen
desc: He works like a tireless machine, giving 100% every time and earning respect from students and teachers alike.

name: Curia Caldwell
desc: Drawn to the strange and unusual, she can't help but poke her nose where it doesn't belong.

name: Ava Ehrenreich
desc: Plays the cute mascot, but behind her smile is a bold strategist already scouting her future husband.

name: Cassiel Longstaff
desc: To calm the track and field club drama, he's scheming to rename it the "Pole Vault Club" and shake things up.

name: Farran Corsa
desc: His weird running style throws off rivals because he's convinced brains beat legs in long-distance races.

name: Geri Spears
desc: A skilled javelin thrower whose smooth throws always fly straight and beautiful, earning cheers every time.

name: Lita Vault
desc: Hurdles are just another dance step as she flies through like gravity forgot to show up.

name: Leero Pard
desc: Running with leopard-like grace and fierce power, he hunts every tenth of a second like a wild beast.

name: Russ Radcliff
desc: Cool and collected under pressure, he nails everything except the one thing—passing the baton.

name: Batton Farrow
desc: Forgetful in life but laser-focused on the baton, he never lets it slip during the race.

name: Jett Allegri
desc: He explodes off the line with raw power and feeds off the crowd's roar to push even harder.

name: Ralya Chersey
desc: She's a lively tomboy who created the rhythmic jump, charging up with a run and her idol's chant.

name: Wing Hyland
desc: With a poker face like a queen, she battles only herself and stays unshaken no matter how low the bar falls.

name: Thalia Petras
desc: Once shy and bookish, she fell for ancient Greek art and now focuses on shot put with fierce passion.

name: Calina Breezer
desc: Always half-asleep and laid-back, she surprises everyone by powering through marathons when there's a prize.

name: Lace Tangler
desc: Clumsy but charmingly airheaded, her biggest problem is shoelaces that won't stay tied, making her trip nonstop.

name: Eli Hoopsen
desc: He's a relentless fireball sweating it out till the final whistle, all while dreaming of winning hearts someday.

name: Marcel Leapman
desc: Athletic and carefree, he's less about winning and more about pulling off slick dribbles that steal the show.

name: Tris Baylor
desc: Convinced that nailing big shots wins hearts, he drills three-pointers nonstop chasing his moment to shine.

name: Dunk Highfield
desc: Obsessed with slam dunks, he dreams big and trains hard in his mind, still chasing that perfect jump in real life.

name: Somnal Brightmore
desc: He pores over a basketball star almanac every day, dreaming of the day he's the one in print.

name: Pillan Hallstead
desc: Holds up a basketball team of rookies with steady hands and a smile, no matter how bad the pass.

name: Leander Courtman
desc: Declares himself the basketball team ace with flair to spare, even though he rarely gets subbed in.

name: Laurence Stumbleton
desc: So focused on the crowd's reaction, he ends up missing the ball and tripping over his feet.

name: Figgo Balpark
desc: Tries to sound like a data pro but blurts out made-up numbers that don't make sense to anyone.

name: Lazaro Coveton
desc: Quietly envies the spotlight, but waits to be noticed just for being himself.

name: Nicolas Pirrant
desc: Loves basketball to death... and totally misread the rankings when signing up to South Cirrus.

name: Hazlo Prophyle
desc: Tried to be the team's shadow hero and avoid the spotlight, but mostly ended up invisible.

name: Emil Tait
desc: Copies pro athletes' bedtime routines for his glow-up plan, hoping it'll help him stand out.

name: Fouad Togenick
desc: Posts daily practice clips and pics, tweaking every angle to look just right.

name: Talken Bigby
desc: A shameless show-off who lies to impress, then panics when his promises fall apart.

name: Jasper Chatterly
desc: Club chairman who leaks juicy idol gossip to the newspaper club. Secrets are his sweet spot.

name: Foster Bracewell
desc: Lives by "Devotion is true love" and gave all for his idol's upcoming graduation concert.

name: Dreamer Havenridge
desc: Feeling down, he met his current idol and has supported her ever since so she can shine.

name: Smiles Thrussell
desc: "An idol's smile can save the world" is his motto as he fires up the crowd to lift his favorite's mood.

name: Noelle Harmon
desc: Sharp hearing means she catches cheers but ignores haters— they're just background noise.

name: Grace Starlet
desc: Now a ninth grader, she lacks confidence in singing and dancing but works hard to keep smiling.

name: Eden Snowbell
desc: A cosmetics expert who pushes her favorites on friends and dreams of starring in commercials.

name: Octavia Carroll
desc: Her vibrant high-pitched voice is praised, and she often helps out as soprano in the choir club.

name: Valentine Lovejoy
desc: A rising idol known for flawless charm at handshake events— everyone who meets her falls hard.

name: Hope Astor
desc: Always watching for fans at school, she charms them with a cute wink when she spots one.

name: Dina Kingston
desc: Known among the female students for her princely image, she secretly wants to wear cute outfits too.

name: Levy Vales
desc: A fan of old-school solo idols, he's searching for a kindred spirit to help debut.

name: Flash Lighton
desc: Throws all his energy into making concerts exciting and has a must-see glow-stick routine.

name: Banner Weaving
desc: Not just a merch collector, he plans to craft goods for his favorite idol too.

name: Finley Brooks
desc: Focused purely on speed, he leads swimmers quietly, unlike the flashy water polo crowd.

name: Alonzo Readdie
desc: The team's number two changes clothes fast— anything to beat the water polo club by a second.

name: Galina Chilvers
desc: Tinted goggles make the perfect cover for sneaky naps after early practice.

name: Rockin Sunshaide
desc: He dreams of designer sunglasses but is fine with his goggles until he can save up.

name: Medwin Silvers
desc: Despite winning only silver medals since childhood, he still feels he's not quite good enough.

name: Kipper Marino
desc: A mysterious boy who swims like he never needs to breathe. Some say he was a fish in a past life.

name: Wale Gambon
desc: He hasn't learned proper technique yet, but his powerful flutter kick makes him fast enough to win.

name: Calem Backstrom
desc: Rough in personality but surprisingly smooth, his silent backstroke barely stirs the water.

name: Castor Fatica
desc: Once hopeless, he worked hard to float and soon started standing out.

name: Papilla Revert
desc: An injury forced her to switch styles, but now she dominates butterfly like no one else.

name: Amita Rudd
desc: Her easygoing breaststroke lets her swim endlessly,  and not even the summer camp coach can keep up.

name: Yarden Forsman
desc: With a killer dolphin kick, he pulls ahead fast. His challenge: lasting long enough to stay ahead.

name: Cheery Allende
desc: Prone to leg cramps, she takes breaks, but her cheers still reach the far edge of the pool.

name: Rafton Calmers
desc: He plays rough but never fouls, always yelling, "The mermaids must love me!"

name: Ballmer Netting
desc: Laid back but a top scorer. If anyone blocks him, he'll throw them into the goal, too.

name: Avan Floane
desc: He loves the floaty feeling lying in bed after games and fights hard to keep his starting spot.

name: Davey Lockers
desc: He plays rough to break opponents' spirits and is known as the "Devil of South Cirrus."

name: Akela Portner
desc: Quick reflexes and height make him a natural goalie, though he's nervous alone but steady in a team.

name: Divar Deepwell
desc: Confident in his lungs, he dives underwater to grab opponents carrying the ball.

name: Cleon Balogh
desc: He tends to pitch only with his left arm but has an extraordinary range of motion to catch the ball.

name: Credence Throwe
desc: He swears the opponent's fouls create the best chances and times his throw-ins perfectly.

name: Ivo Woodward
desc: Never losing balance in rough water, he shuts down one attacker after another with pure core strength.

name: Gentino Sorella
desc: His little sister wants to play, so he's pushing the advisor to start a girls' team.

name: Richter Poole
desc: Worried teammates might get hurt from rough play, he chose to become a referee who never lets it slide.

name: Lior Morrissey
desc: He switched from swimming to water polo club for the wild style, but teammates suspect he's a spy.

name: Focas Quayle
desc: Lately, he's been craving the pure focus of swimming but can't bring himself to leave water polo club.

name: Timmit Bower
desc: Trying to overcome his shyness by acting tough, he still apologizes every time he bumps someone.

name: Izekiel Truth
desc: A science geek with more knowledge than anyone at school, he dismisses the occult and trusts only facts.

name: Gemma Coombs
desc: Having met her grandmother's ghost, she's ready to try anything to see her again.

name: Fuyo Catcher
desc: He built a drone to track UFOs, but it moves so fast even he can't control it.

name: Eviden Tracer
desc: He tackles every problem like a case, always saying, "Science never lies!" as he digs into analysis.

name: Murray Hollowpot
desc: Son of a famous local pub where ghosts come for the food and strange tapping noises never stop.

name: Morrigan Shutterly
desc: Her hobby is studying ghost photos, always hunting for proof and hoping to snap one herself.

name: Sylas Saxton
desc: A genius who never studies, he spends all his time cracking codes instead of hitting the books.

name: Ferdy Fenwick
desc: Once obsessed with the occult, he now lives for science— but hasn't told his clubmates yet.

name: Hazel Woodrow
desc: Once, she missed her stop and ended up at a creepy station, but she walked all the way home by sheer will.

name: Ouijane Boarden
desc: She made an AI Ouija divination board game, but her friends are too scared to try it.

name: Flaurine Woodwind
desc: A passionate Reyes fan who sees other supporters as rivals and is picky about selecting ensemble members.

name: Kellan Beatley
desc: A skilled percussionist who loves rare instruments and has become a bit of a collector.

name: Louise Basson
desc: A strict but reliable bass section leader who trains hard to win first place in contests.

name: Claudette Clackenoff
desc: An attention seeker who loves castanets and dreams of performing a solo performance someday.

name: Brooke Reedman
desc: He broke a club veteran's clarinet but is too scared to admit it or ask for repairs.

name: Cornelia Hoopett
desc: A quaint girl who loves round things and became a horn player because of its looping tubes.

name: Penelope Mozartin
desc: A classical music fan who knows all about the great composers, and wishes she lived in their time.

name: Brianna Summing
desc: A modest girl who wants the spotlight once and plans to cheer on the baseball club on local news.

name: Henrietta Kettingham
desc: Stickler for etiquette who'll fix your bow angle and your instrument's position before you can say "tuning."

name: Marjorie Piperplume
desc: A bird lover who picked up the flute just to play duets with her feathered friends.

name: Dizzy Fumbleton
desc: She's clumsy but always saves her instrument first because bruises heal faster than repair bills.

name: Donovan Brasswagon
desc: His trombone's loud, but his dance moves are louder— clear a path when he starts to play.

name: Liselotte Heartsway
desc: She joined for love, not music, hoping a certain baseball club boy would notice her from the brass section.

name: Jaslyn Warbleton
desc: She's a jazz natural with riffs so smooth even the teacher forgets to critique.

name: Francesca Fintootle
desc: She dreams of blasting cheers on her trumpet but secretly doubts her lungs can keep up.

name: Ezekiel Gravendirge
desc: Learned to exorcise spirits with nothing but a hum and now clears bad vibes just by singing to himself.

name: Regis Tunesmith
desc: A future conductor already in command, he swaps pens for a baton in every class.

name: Vincent Melodin
desc: Lets out a gorgeous melody when spooked, which only makes him a bigger target for prank-lovers.

name: Renee Sirensong
desc: Her first cry made the obstetrician weep, and she's been silencing rooms with her voice ever since.

name: Monica Kinbird
desc: She nails any classmate's voice perfectly and switches styles so fast you can't tell which one's hers.

name: Sonata Cherub
desc: Claims to be an angel, and honestly, her voice is enough to make you believe it.

name: Allegra Langton
desc: Her notes go on forever thanks to breath control that even athletes envy.

name: Millicent Vociere
desc: A warm-hearted newcomer who sings any part she's given and nails it every time.

name: Selena Sopralis
desc: A crystal-clear soprano whose voice is so pure it sometimes disappears into thin air.

name: Rondo Harmond
desc: Handles every instrument the choir club needs and somehow plays them all like he was born for it.

name: Aretha Rumbell
desc: Her voice rumbles low and deep with a rich vibrato that shakes you to your bones.

name: Hexine Cantation
desc: They say she sings a cursed carol that leaves you dazed, dreamy, and begging for more.

name: Rockson Grohl
desc: Lives for music and worships rock, but can't shake the feeling most join the club just to look cool.

name: Sadley Lonsom
desc: Falls hard and fast but luck's never on his side, leaving heartbreaks and sad guitar tunes in his wake.

name: Blossom Laine
desc: Raised on visual kei, she turns heads and fires up the crowd with legendary headbanging moves.

name: Thompson Hummings
desc: Started as a rookie craving attention but earned his spot through nonstop grind and steady charm.

name: Trebor Donders
desc: He turned restless legs into thunderous drums with a double bass speed that floors the crowd.

name: Liron Suesskind
desc: Keeps his voice sharp by sneaking candy all through class— no teacher ever catches him.

name: Marius Harlow
desc: Obsessed with carrying his instrument every day he built crazy stamina even as an indoors kid.

name: Raya Sixstring
desc: A lone wolf chasing singer-songwriter dreams whose street performances stop people in their tracks.

name: Minna Smallwood
desc: Quirky collector who matches her favorite bandmate's gear and dreams of jamming side by side.

name: Cleara Sounds
desc: Hardcore earphone nerd with an encyclopedic ear for sound who won't touch wireless buds for anything.

name: Hop Sadler
desc: Bassist with a pedal obsession who never plug them in but loves staring at his colorful collection.

name: Bang Revell
desc: Can't play a note but owns the stage with his killer air guitar moves that steal the spotlight every time.

name: Verica Nyman
desc: Obsessed with gossip, she spins wild tales to keep the rumor mill buzzing just the way she likes it.

name: Aldus Ogden
desc: Kicked out of the newspaper club by Nyman, he's stuck mourning the shift from print to endless SNS posts.

name: Veronica Camry
desc: A camera whiz who's the idol-lovers club's go-to for flawless on-site shots that capture every perfect moment.

name: Cora Inkton
desc: Writes a beloved corner column in the school paper where her warm stories brighten readers' days.

name: Uriah Goldfield
desc: Relentless in chasing mischief, he digs up dirt and spreads the wildest stories right alongside Nyman.

name: Adal Miramond
desc: Aims to outdo the occult society by digging up and sharing the creepiest mysteries available.

name: Trace Combe
desc: Proofreads the manga club's four-panel comics with care while quietly dreaming of launching his own series.

name: Tito De Core
desc: Masters flashy headlines that grab attention but sometimes stray so far they spark a storm of complaints.

name: Fiona Leroux
desc: Instead of bashing school romances, she's all about backing them and shaking up old-school attitudes.

name: Nance Meridian
desc: She knows sensational sells but sticks to her ideals, never trading integrity for clicks or headlines.

name: Memo Rize
desc: Has a photographic memory and catches every word in interviews with perfect recall, no recorder needed!

name: Krome Tallic
desc: Obsessed with metal—rocks, not riffs—and somehow recruits lost metalheads into the mineral club instead.

name: Jewelyn Plunkett
desc: Admires jewels but thinks they're kinda cheesy, so she hides her nerves behind fierce punk rocker makeup.

name: Gildred Gainstead
desc: Drawn to gold for its steady value, he pours every New Year's allowance into his shiny stash.

name: Ezrail Corbell
desc: A die-hard rail fan disguised as a rocker who surprises everyone with his polite, down-to-earth nature.

name: Culinaro Brons
desc: Collects cooking tools like a pro but can't cook a fried egg to save his life—irony served hot.

name: Elian Kitronic
desc: The electronics store's top guy so valued they wish they could clone him for every shift and customer.

name: Slater Verbenbaum
desc: Aims to craft music that leaves a mark, not tears. Just that unforgettable feeling that stays long after.

name: Kurtz Armishaw
desc: Hooked on weapons and their pull but always short on cash to build the collection he dreams of having.

name: Tessa Rapperton
desc: A chatterbox turned rapper who keeps her disses gentle since trash talk isn't her style.

name: Miriam Masheene
desc: Obsessed with anything mechanical that moves, especially the exposed guts of industrial machines.

name: Armani Armure
desc: Loved armor so much he tried wearing it to class but gave up after his parents put their foot down.

name: Gusmin Strelbard
desc: Got a unique, beautiful voice that no one else can match, all thanks to grandma's shigin lessons.

name: Jayce Chorden
desc: Blasts his guitar loud to blow off steam because it's about shaking the whole room, not headphones.

name: Tobias Thumpern
desc: Switched from taiko to drums chasing a dream but finds the thin sticks oddly unsatisfying to hold.

name: Kara Okenridge
desc: Loves singing for crowds and often drowns out others with her loud karaoke harmonies.

name: Kohara Staley
desc: Dreams of catching the Kraken and spends every day tracking sightings and witness reports.

name: Kye Sendon
desc: Loves fish so much he studies and eats them— spot a bowl of seafood and he's already lining up.

name: Jella Fisker
desc: Drifts like a jellyfish, she's quiet and easygoing until she drops a venomous remark that stings hard.

name: Salpida Longwheel
desc: From a family of twins and triplets, her family gatherings always overflow with doppelgangers.

name: Ezra Bachmann
desc: Always carrying fresh food, he's ready for any surprise meeting with unknown sea creatures.

name: Evon Newground
desc: Believes krakens are ocean-floor humans and is determined to find a way to talk with them.

name: Barrac Kuda
desc: A free-diving sea hunter whose lightning-fast swimming snags anything that crosses his path.

name: Mako Carcher
desc: A lover of sharks and low-budget shark flicks who surprises many with her passion and enthusiasm.

name: Inga Calmari
desc: An eccentric researcher exploring squid ink's secrets who lately experimenting with ink painting.

name: Azure Marcet
desc: Fascinated by the ocean floor but uneasy around deep-sea fish. He visits exhibitions to adjust.

name: Octavian Da Lua
desc: Can't resist tight dark spaces and once got stuck in the club room needing a rescue.

name: Megal O'Donn
desc: Once a dinosaur fanatic, now hooked on sharks and imagines epic battles to crown the strongest.

name: Tempest Liebkind
desc: Usually gentle and soothing, her anger is so fierce it can reduce the whole club to tears.

name: Griffin Fastwell
desc: Lost an esports match to a delayed click and swore never again; now he trains his body as seriously as his APM.

name: Sienna Fairborn
desc: Dominates the ranked ladder on stream with skills so sharp even adults get quiet when she plays.

name: Lockin Somnal
desc: Even asleep he's grinding aim trainers to perfect his signature move: the clean 180 headshot.

name: Aeron Rushmore
desc: Racing games got him hooked on speed, so now he bikes everywhere just to chase that feeling in real life.

name: Grayson Tiltwood
desc: He swears he's a puzzle god, but every time he loses, it's gravity's fault, not his.

name: Calix Virtus
desc: Maxed out his stats in real life and moved on to the virtual world, aiming to perfect the brain too.

name: Torwyn Endeavor
desc: Wants a rival to train with, someone who'll push him until they both face the whole world together.

name: Torric Brawnstone
desc: Bulking up to look scary in the lobby, he crushes high-calorie meals like they're power-ups.

name: Cassia Bladecroft
desc: Known across FPS circles as "Slash'n Cut," a gamer tag that makes even veterans flinch.

name: Actie Verran
desc: She trains like a pro and wants her chance, but every time she grabs the controller, they tell her to wait.

name: Ellie Fumble
desc: Trains daily just to keep up with her little brothers, but can't walk straight without bumping into a wall.

name: Biijiro Onoda
desc: His newspaper follows one guy's wild dream to go from average to unstoppable student council president.

name: Kujira Torikawa
desc: Every special move he dreams up hits big in his manga, and he hopes Dora-meown Ball gets published.

name: Romain Romanze
desc: He reads more shōjo manga than anyone and dishes out romance advice that always lands perfectly.

name: Edton Prentt
desc: The club's ruthless editor who bends over backwards to crush deadlines no matter what it takes.

name: Drewey Fournell
desc: Sticks to four-panel manga because going beyond that just burns him out fast.

name: Edith Endenwald
desc: Convinced every great manga ends with an explosion, she rewrites others' endings just to stir the pot.

name: Harolde Narcissus
desc: A total narcissist, he draws manga just to share his own flawless beauty with the world.

name: Manon Matopia
desc: Reads manga aloud with perfect voice acting for every onomatopoeia like it's the main show.

name: Soria Bordeau
desc: Called the Empress of Storyboards, she wins hearts with dialogue that hits deep despite her subpar art.

name: Norah Noshawn
desc: Shows up twice a year like a ghost, but drops thoughtful manga feedback before vanishing again.

name: Puffet Vearn
desc: Joined the council just to be near Lilac— one kind word from her and he's all in.

name: Glorian Flaunt
desc: Loves bragging about test scores, then walks you through the answers with a glowing smile.

name: Rhianna Wardholdt
desc: Keeps a sharp eye out for rule-breakers and runs the school committee like a well-oiled machine.

name: Ordin Scriben
desc: Polite on the surface, but underneath? He wrote 1,710 pages of rules and you better follow every one.

name: Coraline Quisittor
desc: Looks quiet and mild, but when she glares, even the teachers straighten up.

name: Judis Nitcher
desc: Seems like he'd be popular, but his habit of snitching to teachers has everyone steering clear.

name: Lawton Dappermann
desc: Spends two hours getting ready every morning and dreams of turning the whole planet into model students.

name: Rudgar Dennings
desc: Doesn't look it, but he's a total softie who spends his afternoons quietly tending the flowerbeds.

name: Hardan Kempton
desc: Obsessed with beautification and always handing out flyers, yet forgets to tame his own wild hair.

name: Montgomery Marchand
desc: A kind cheerleading captain who always backs the underdog— even switching sides mid-game.

name: Elmer Trommel
desc: Runs the squad like a human metronome, keeping every chant sharp and perfectly in sync.

name: Cane Fangley
desc: Stands with Wulfgang to defy the elites, though part of him secretly admires those he's rebelling against.

name: Fenric Wulfgang
desc: Leads the Wolves & Dogs with a fierce grudge against the elites and no interest in making peace.

name: Romica Glimmerly
desc: Top dog of the Chipper Girl "Queens," she plays her role perfectly to gather intel on snagging a rich future.

name: Stran Linemont
desc: As soon as the bell rings, he's out the door like a rocket— no one clears the school grounds faster.

name: Lacie Pawford
desc: Says she's an indoors girl, but her dog drags her into a nightly showdown over walk time.

name: Marcol Leapstone
desc: With monkey-like reflexes and endless stamina, he turns the trip to school into a full-blown parkour run.

name: Ignacio Gerhardt
desc: A walking ball of justice who can't stand wrongdoers, he idolizes Ferrell and keeps his fire burning bright.

name: Rynor Rushenfort
desc: Stubbornly upbeat no matter what, he's powered through every obstacle with pure force of will.

name: Crag Bolderin
desc: Gave up mountain climbing and picked a flatland school, but treats the stairs like his personal summit.

name: Bowie Buffoon
desc: Lives to make people laugh, and when words fail him, he lets his goofy moves do the talking.

name: Margot Napier
desc: Sleeps through most classes yet somehow tops the grades —rumor has it she studies in her dreams.

name: Colette Brushmont
desc: Art nerd aiming for the top, and once she starts talking about painting, there's no stopping her.

name: Blue Cleverley
desc: Loves both Go and shogi but feels stuck in the middle of the two clubs' awkward rivalry.

name: Matilde Pendlebury
desc: Her friends always count on her, but she finds it tough to ask for help herself.

name: Niro Vannaburg
desc: So obsessed with Krakburgers he can sniff one and tell which shop it came from.

name: Heather Lovella
desc: A new recruit with a thing for romance gossip whose memorized every love-themed poetry card in the set.

name: Brannon Chalant
desc: Drifts through school on autopilot, slowly growing anxious about how aimless life feels.

name: Jayden Durance
desc: Struggles with breathing technique, but with a kickboard and stamina to spare, he just keeps going.

name: Capricia Saiz
desc: Calm and consistent as a setter, she's gained quiet fans thanks to her flawless tosses and rare soft smile.

name: Colm Dawdlin
desc: Hard at work on a new programming language he hopes to finish before graduation.

name: Adelaide Plainhart
desc: She wanted a quiet junior high life, but her elegant tea ceremony skills keep her in the spotlight.

name: Sami Wampovich
desc: Turned down the marine biology club to study river life solo in total peace and quiet.

name: Alphonse Wreckenbach
desc: Top student by grades, but at the table he's the "King of Destruction," always smashing the ball by accident.

name: Annie Glenvale
desc: A bold dancer with talent to spare—once the music hits, her body just moves.

name: Fitzbon Vivant
desc: Recreates meals from manga with chef-level skill and posts every masterpiece online.

name: Rico Falsettis
desc: Part of the children's choir since a young age, he dreams of leading the tenor role once his voice catches up.

name: Amadeus Lyland
desc: Spends weekends sailing to far-off islands chasing the perfect surf spots.

name: Aila Pavey
desc: Always digging into occult rumors at school, especially recent sightings of the elusive Kraken.

name: Emi Blanchett
desc: Training hard in the dance club, she's set on breaking into showbiz and becoming a top idol.

name: Colleen Evenholm
desc: She's on a mission to keep both the school app and the old-school newspaper alive, side by side.

name: Emery Hillmere
desc: He sprints uphill to school every morning to build stamina for marathon relays, then arrives totally wiped.

name: Vane Nishmont
desc: Still trying to retrieve the money from a magic trick, even though it's been in his pocket all along.

name: Juniper Cushionne
desc: Loves the xylophone so much she's always got a dozen mallets hidden in her bag.

name: Nadia Watershed
desc: Figured a sports club might be fun, and badminton seemed chill enough to give it a try.

name: Victorio Cryptix
desc: Courageous and justice-driven grandson of Dr. Cryptix, who sets off with Wonderbot to find the strongest eleven.

name: Misty
desc: Wonderbot's little sister and the latest android model, she acts as a tour guide for Vic and his crew.

name: Fei Rune
desc: Officer of the Unidentified Enemy Response Committee who partners with Dr. Cryptix to save the world.

name: Victorio Cryptix
desc: Vic in his football days, brimming with energy and eager to show his mother exactly what he's capable of.

name: Lumina
desc: A disciplined professional with much on her plate, yet her love for Vic shines as brightly as her name.

name: Zanark Avalonic
desc: A wild card who escaped the CONTRA Facility and gained new powers from his future self.

name: Hurricane Zeta
desc: The largest typhoon ever to bring destruction and chaos, and wielder of new powers granted by Zanark.

name: Dvalin
desc: A control freak who won't rest until everything's perfect, and wielder of new powers granted by Zanark.

name: Caleb Stonewall
desc: A shadow player who once pulled strings at Royal Academy Redux, and wielder of new powers granted by Zanark.

name: Destra
desc: Leader of Devil Army Z who devours human souls, and wielder of new powers granted by Zanark.

name: Bash Lancer
desc: The lone soldier who rules as the strongest at Ogre Academy, and wielder of new powers granted by Zanark.

name: Ryoma Nishiki
